# Rincoin

Rincoin is a proof-of-work digital currency for direct settlement and
self-custody. It uses the UTXO ledger model and cumulative-proof-of-work chain
selection. Independent full nodes validate transactions and blocks; miners
order transactions by extending the valid chain with the greatest cumulative
work [@rincoinCore2026deployed].

The design combines one-minute target blocks with a memory-hard proof-of-work
function and finite, predictable issuance. It favours a compact base layer,
transparent validation rules, open-source software, and direct control of
private keys.
